item.title: El pueblo que España sepultó bajo su propia mina: nació en el siglo XVIII y allí se jugó el primer partido de fútbol
item.description: Fernando Durán guarda la única llave de un edificio gigantesco y vacío en Huelva. Dentro, una maqueta reconstruye casa por casa el pueblo donde nació, hoy sepultado bajo toneladas de residuo minero. Durán, 42 años después , es uno de los dos o tres supervivientes que aún pueden contar cómo era vivir allí antes de que la mina se lo tragara entero. Fue la Corona. La explotación moderna arranca en 1725, cuando la corona rehabilita la mina de la mano del ingeniero sueco Liebert Wolters. Por entonces reinaba Felipe V, y fue la administración real la que decidió reactivar unas minas que llevaban… Fuente: Xataka.

item.description: Former Celtic captain Scott Brown believes a win for the Scottish champions against Rangers on Sunday "changes the game" after a turbulent week for Martin O'Neill's side. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Britain beat Germany to win World Championship bronze
item.description: Great Britain men's team win bronze at the Wheelchair Basketball World Championships by defeating Germany, but GB women lose out in third-place play-off. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Coventry win first points of season in dramatic win over Forest
item.description: Jay Dasilva's strike proves the difference as Coventry earn their first Premier League win since returning to the top flight. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Ashton hat-trick sees Warrington end Hull KR's reign
item.description: Matty Ashton scores a hat-trick as Warrington Wolves end Hull Kingston Rovers' reign as Super League champions with victory in the play-off eliminator. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Brighton humbling 'a big lesson' for Arsenal - Arteta
item.description: An uncharacteristic performance from Arsenal saw the Gunners ship three goals in the defeat to Brighton - but could the loss be the "big lesson" they needed? Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: 'Greater things to come,' says Mitchell after England winning run ends
item.description: Head coach John Mitchell says England's thrilling draw with Canada will inspire "greater things to come" from the world champions despite the result ending their record-breaking winning streak. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Everton's unbeaten run continues with win over 10-man Ipswich
item.description: Unbeaten Everton move up to fifth in the Premier League, with Thierno Barry's goal making the difference against 10-man Ipswich Town. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Newcastle hold off Hull at St James' Park
item.description: Newcastle United hold off a late Hull City fightback to seal a narrow 2-1 win. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Brighton cruise past Arsenal to end champions' perfect start
item.description: Brighton secure a 3-0 victory over Premier League champions Arsenal to inflict the Gunners' first defeat of the season. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Spurs lose again as Villa hold on for first league win
item.description: Aston Villa pick up their first win of the Premier League season after five matches, holding off a late push from a Tottenham Hotspur side who remain without a win in the league. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: New Zealand cruise to victory over Scotland in WXV
item.description: Scotland suffer a second successive defeat in the WXV Global Series as New Zealand run out comfortable winners at Hive Stadium. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.description: Rory McIlroy stands two strokes behind the third-round leaders heading into the final day after a three-under 72 at the BMW PGA Championship at Wentworth. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: 'Look at this!' - McIlroy in contention after eagle on 18th
item.description: Rory McIlroy climbs the leaderboard in the PGA Championship after an eagle on the 18th hole at Wentworth Club in Virginia Water, Surrey. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Malard scores on debut as Chelsea beat Birmingham
item.description: Melvine Malard scores on her WSL debut for Chelsea as the Blues run out as comfortable winners against Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Frenetic draw with Canada ends England's 39-game winning run
item.description: England's remarkable winning run comes to an end as they are held to a nail-biting 26-26 draw by Canada at Sandy Park. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: England thump Sri Lanka to sweep T20 series 3-0
item.description: England steamroll Sri Lanka to complete a 3-0 series clean sweep and return to number one in the T20 world rankings. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: England's 39-match winning streak halted by thrilling draw with Canada
item.description: England's winning record - stretching back to a loss in the 2022 World Cup final to New Zealand - was halted by Canada, who held the hosts to a thrilling 26-26 draw in the WXV Global Series. Fuente: BBC Sport.
